basic_details.short_information: Office of the Chief Medical Officer of Health & Secretary, District Health & Family Welfare Samity, Birbhum (National Health Mission), Suri, West Bengal, has invited applications for 47 posts in 9 roles under Advt No. DHFWS-II/HR-2026/774. The posts include Multi Rehabilitation Worker under NPHCE, Staff Nurse under NUHM/15th FC, Community Health Assistant for U-HWC/NUHM, Senior Treatment Laboratory Supervisor - STLS (under NTEP) and 5 more. The online application is open from 6 November 2026 to 27 November 2026.

content_sections.text: Shortlisting on academic qualification (and experience where stated) Interview, computer test or written test as specified for each post Merit by scale of scoring Multi Rehabilitation Worker: after paper verification, interview; 50 marks Staff Nurse: academic 80 marks plus experience up to 20 marks Community Health Assistant: merit by percentage in ANM or GNM examination TBHV and STLS: 1:20 shortlisting by academic qualification and experience; practical computer test Medical Officer GDMO: MBBS 85 marks and interview 15 marks Block Programme Coordinator: document scrutiny, then academic result, experience, written test and computer skill test

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for District Health & Family Welfare Samity, Birbhum Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Visit www.wbhealth.gov.in and use the link 'On-line Recruitment'. Register online by midnight of 25 November 2026 and keep the application id and registration number. Pay the fee online through net banking or credit/debit card by midnight of 25 November 2026; do not pay more than once. After successful payment, return to the link and complete final submission with the application id by midnight of 27 November 2026. Upload proper signature and photograph. Download the print copy from http://hr.wbhealth.gov.in;8888/Index.aspx -> 'Application Print' and keep it for document verification; do not send it by post.

faq.answer: The last date is 27 November 2026. Applications opened on 6 November 2026.

faq.answer: There are 47 vacancies: 6 Multi Rehabilitation Worker under NPHCE, 12 Staff Nurse under NUHM/15th FC, 10 Community Health Assistant for U-HWC/NUHM, 1 Senior Treatment Laboratory Supervisor - STLS (under NTEP), 1 TBHV (under NTEP), 4 Medical Officer GDMO (NHM) for FRU and 3 more posts.

faq.answer: It depends on the post - Multi Rehabilitation Worker under NPHCE: minimum 21 years to Maximum 40 years; Staff Nurse under NUHM/15th FC: 21 to 40 years; Community Health Assistant for U-HWC/NUHM: 21 to 40 years; Senior Treatment Laboratory Supervisor - STLS (under NTEP): minimum 21 years and maximum 40 years or less; TBHV (under NTEP): minimum 21 years and maximum 40 years or less.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: 18000.00 per month consolidated for Multi Rehabilitation Worker under NPHCE, 25000.00 per month Consolidated for Staff Nurse under NUHM/15th FC, Rs. 13000.00 per month consolidated for Community Health Assistant for U-HWC/NUHM, 25000.00 per month for Senior Treatment Laboratory Supervisor - STLS (under NTEP), 18000.00 per month for TBHV (under NTEP).

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: MBBS for Medical Officer; GNM with WBNC registration for Staff Nurse; ANM or GNM with WBNC registration for Community Health Assistant; Bachelor degree in Physiotherapy with 2 years' hospital experience for Multi Rehabilitation Worker; Graduate with DMLT/BMLT for STLS; Graduate in Science with 1 year experience for TBHV; Master's degree in listed subjects or Graduate degree for Block Programme Coordinator. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.
